lessons.title: Sports Day Practice: Running Races
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to run in a straight line towards a finish point with control.
lessons.main_activity: Practise simple running races in small groups, focusing on running in a straight line and finishing safely.
key_questions: How do you stay in your lane?
What do you do at the finish line?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note running control and spatial awareness — evidence for PD.1.
lessons.plenary: Cool down and celebrate everyone's effort.

lessons.title: Good Sportsmanship
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to congratulate a friend on their effort, win or lose.
lessons.starter_activity: Discuss what good sportsmanship looks like.
lessons.main_activity: Practise congratulating teammates/opponents after races today, focusing on kind words regardless of outcome.
key_questions: How do we behave if we don't come first?
How do we celebrate a friend's win?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note emotional regulation and prosocial behaviour in a competitive context — evidence for PSED.3/PSED.1.
lessons.plenary: Recap examples of good sportsmanship seen today.
lessons.home_link: Practise good sportsmanship during a game at home.

lessons.title: Making Sports Day Medals
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to construct and decorate a medal for sports day.
lessons.main_activity: Children make and decorate a card medal with ribbon, ready to be awarded during sports day.
key_questions: How are you decorating your medal?
Who might you give it to?
lessons.assessment_notes: Observe fine motor and creative choice — evidence for EAD.1/PD.2.
lessons.plenary: Display medals ready for sports day.
lessons.home_link: Make a medal or award for a family member's achievement.

lessons.title: Sports Day Practice: Relay and Team Games
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to participate in a relay, passing a baton/object to a teammate.
lessons.main_activity: Practise simple relay races in teams, focusing on passing the baton/object safely and cheering teammates.
key_questions: How do you pass the baton safely?
How can you cheer for your team?

differentiation.extension: Add a more complex relay pattern

lessons.assessment_notes: Note teamwork and coordination — evidence for PD.1/PSED.3.
lessons.plenary: Cool down and celebrate team efforts.
lessons.home_link: Play a simple relay or team game with family.

lessons.title: Trying My Best
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to describe what 'trying your best' means to them.
lessons.starter_activity: Discuss that sports day is about trying your best, not just winning.
lessons.main_activity: Children reflect on what trying their best looked like in today's practice, sharing examples.
key_questions: What did trying your best look like today?
How did it feel to try hard?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note growth mindset language and self-reflection — evidence for PSED.1.
lessons.home_link: Talk about trying your best at something this week.

lessons.title: Making Bunting for the Celebration
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to create a decorative flag for class bunting.
lessons.main_activity: Children decorate a triangular flag using paint/craft materials, to be strung together as class bunting for the end-of-year celebration.
resources_needed: Triangular card/fabric flags, craft materials, string
key_questions: How are you decorating your flag?
What does it represent about your year?

differentiation.extension: Add a pattern or symbol representing a favourite memory

lessons.assessment_notes: Observe creative expression and fine motor skill — evidence for EAD.1.
lessons.plenary: String bunting together and display it.
lessons.home_link: Make a decoration for a celebration at home.

lessons.title: Sports Day Practice: Throwing and Jumping
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to throw a beanbag towards a target and jump for distance with control.
lessons.main_activity: Practise throwing beanbags at targets and standing long jump, focusing on technique and control.
key_questions: How do you aim the beanbag?
How do you land safely when jumping?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note throwing accuracy and jumping technique — evidence for PD.1.
lessons.plenary: Cool down and celebrate everyone's effort.
lessons.home_link: Practise throwing and jumping safely outside.

lessons.title: Cheering for Our Team
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to support and encourage their team during an activity.
lessons.main_activity: During today's practice, children take turns being active participants and cheering supporters for their team.
key_questions: How did you cheer for your team?
How did it feel to be cheered for?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note team spirit and encouragement behaviour — evidence for PSED.3.
lessons.plenary: Recap the positive team spirit shown today.
lessons.home_link: Cheer for a family member trying something new.

lessons.title: Practising the End-of-Year Song
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to join in singing an end-of-year celebration song with actions.
lessons.starter_activity: Listen to the chosen end-of-year song.
lessons.main_activity: Practise singing the song with actions, reflecting on memories from the year as they sing.
key_questions: What memory does this song remind you of?
Can you remember the actions?

differentiation.extension: Suggest a new action or verse

lessons.assessment_notes: Note participation and reflective connection to the year's learning — evidence for EAD.2/PSED.1.
lessons.plenary: Perform the song once more together.
lessons.home_link: Practise singing the song at home.

lessons.title: Sports Day Dress Rehearsal
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to participate confidently in a full run-through of sports day events.
lessons.main_activity: Full dress rehearsal of sports day events (running, relay, throwing, jumping) in sequence.
key_questions: Which event did you enjoy most?
How did it feel to do them all together?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note overall physical confidence and stamina across a range of skills — evidence for PD.1, summarising the year's PD progress.
lessons.plenary: Cool down and celebrate the rehearsal.
lessons.home_link: Rest and prepare for sports day tomorrow/soon.

lessons.title: Reflecting on a Year of Growth
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to reflect on their overall confidence and emotional growth across the year.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap the whole year's PSED journey (feelings, friendships, independence).
lessons.main_activity: Children reflect on how their confidence and feelings have grown since September, sharing with the group.
key_questions: How has your confidence grown this year?
What are you most proud of?

differentiation.extension: Explain growth in detail with examples

lessons.assessment_notes: Final PSED reflection for the EYFS profile — evidence for PSED.1.
lessons.plenary: Class celebration of everyone's emotional growth this year.
lessons.home_link: Share your reflections on this year with your family.

lessons.title: Final Rehearsal: End-of-Year Celebration
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to perform the end-of-year song and any other favourite performances confidently.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap the song and any other performance elements.
lessons.main_activity: Full rehearsal of the end-of-year celebration performance, combining the song with bunting and medals display.
resources_needed: Craft from the week, music player
key_questions: How confident do you feel about tomorrow's celebration?
What are you looking forward to performing?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note performance confidence — evidence for EAD.2, summarising the year's EAD progress.
lessons.home_link: Practise your part of the celebration at home.

lessons.title: Sports Day!
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to participate in sports day events with confidence, control, and good sportsmanship.
lessons.main_activity: Sports day event: running races, relay, throwing, and jumping events, with medals awarded for participation and effort.
resources_needed: All sports day equipment, medals made this week
key_questions: Which event was your favourite?
How did you show good sportsmanship?

differentiation.extension: Participate fully independently and encourage others

lessons.assessment_notes: Final PD summary for the EYFS profile, reflecting a full year of gross motor development — evidence for PD.1/PD.2.
lessons.plenary: Award medals and celebrate everyone's participation and effort.
lessons.home_link: Celebrate sports day with your family!

lessons.title: End of Year Celebration Circle
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to express pride and joy in completing their Reception year.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap the whole year from September to now.
lessons.main_activity: Final celebration circle time where children share their proudest moment from the whole year and say goodbye to Reception.
resources_needed: Photos/work samples from across the year
key_questions: What is your proudest moment from this year?
How do you feel about finishing Reception?

differentiation.support: Point to a photo and share simply

lessons.assessment_notes: Final PSED reflection completing the full EYFS profile — evidence for PSED.1/PSED.2/PSED.3 across the whole year.
lessons.plenary: Whole-class celebration marking the end of a wonderful Reception year.
lessons.home_link: Celebrate finishing Reception with your family this weekend!

lessons.title: End-of-Year Celebration Performance
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to perform the end-of-year song and display their work with pride and confidence.
lessons.starter_activity: Final warm-up and recap of the performance.
lessons.main_activity: The class performs the end-of-year celebration song for parents/carers, with bunting, medals, and the year's work on display.
resources_needed: Full craft/decorations from the week, music player
key_questions: How did it feel to perform?
What are you most proud of showing your family?

differentiation.support: Adult provides reassurance and prompts as needed
differentiation.extension: Perform independently with full confidence and expression

lessons.assessment_notes: Final EAD performance summary completing the full EYFS profile — evidence for EAD.1/EAD.2 across the whole year.
lessons.plenary: Whole-class and whole-family celebration marking a fantastic end to EYFS — congratulations to every child on completing Reception and being ready for Year 1!
lessons.home_link: Celebrate this wonderful achievement together as a family!
